MemeDef.label: Anarchism
MemeDef.description: All of us are naturally anarchists at heart.

rulesStrings.li: memeAdjective->anarchistic
memeConcept->anarchism
creation(tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism) ->[deity0_name] fashioned a society without government. Each one is a unique and precious miracles by [deity0_possessive] divine hand.
episode(uses=1,tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism) ->[deity0_name] said to all, "Each and every free spirit is a unique and holy being formed in my image."
intro(tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism) ->[deity0_name] spoke to [memberNamePlural] [revelationAdverb], guiding each to travel to the [place_summary] [place_name] where their unique history would shine.
conflict(tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism) ->The [foeLeader] forced the [memberNamePlural] to obey the state's power and work in [foeLeader_possessive] [place_community].

founderJoin(tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism) ->A [place_job] named [founderName] was blessed by [deity0_name] and gained miraculous knowledge of the unique freedom of each and every [memberName]. [founder_pronoun] said to each one what they needed to spread their newfound freedom.

victory(tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism) ->The [memberNamePlural] gathered in a secret conference with many of the [foeSoldiers]. They all learned to see the value in each other and abandon the [foeLeader]'s [place_community].

setup(tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism) ->Oppressed by distant rulers who demanded the submission of the working class, [founderName] created a rebel movement that smashed the state and brought freedom to those in need.
story(uses=1,tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism) ->[founderName] broke every law the oppressors tried to enforce, just to show that they were unjust.
lessonIntro(tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism) ->My family, my clan, my team - they all tried to keep a shroud over my eyes to stop me from seeing a simple fact:
lesson(tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism) ->"From each according to his ability, to each according to his needs"
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism) ->But that was only my path - What will yours be?
archistBasis(tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism) ->Archotechs stand as heroes against oppression, and recognize and judge each of us individually the same way.
archistFact(tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism) ->At death, the archotechs examine the unique needs of each individual.
archistFact(tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism) ->Archotechs notice the relics of society, such as the [relic1_name].

archistProphecy(tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism) ->[inTheEnd], the archotechs will depart. They will bring with them the ones they have noticed, and leave the rest behind to reside peacefully in the universe's eternal entropy.
animistBasis(tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism) ->Before everything, there was a pantheon of spirits, each free. These came together in conference to create the world.
animistFact(tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism) ->Every spirit lends its unique nature to our world, and they expect us to do the same.
serketistProphecy(tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism)->[itIsSaid] we will learn from them, and use that knowledge to liberate the universe.
chthonianProphecy(tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism)->We will acquire their eldritch knowledge, and use it to liberate the universe.
esotericismProphecy(tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism)->With such knowledge, we will have a clear advantage over the rest of this planet's inhabitants, and use it to liberate it.
eschatologismFact(tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism)->There will be nothing left. But together we will rebuild society from the ground up.
introMemo(tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism)->As you know, the mission of our Company is way too important to let others get in our way, so we are preparing a overthrow of the state.
alienistProphecy(tag=meme_RTC_Anarchism)->We need to spread by reason the reality of life, seeded by humanity through all the Rim.

MemeDef.label: Syndicalism
MemeDef.description: In Labor movements generally, success through violence can hardly be expected except in circumstances where success without violence is attainable.
